en.title: Stanford Physicist and GPT-6 Astra Propose a Four-Dimensional Quantum Gravity Framework
en.excerpt: An 83-page preprint from arXiv claims a background-independent, nonperturbative quantization of vacuum general relativity, with the author crediting months of collaboration with GPT-6 Astra and roughly 400 million tokens. The paper is not peer-reviewed and is not a theory of everything.
en.content:
**What was posted:** On November 25, arXiv user Venkatesa Chandrasekaran submitted *An algebraic quantization of gravity from the null cone* (arXiv:2611.34924). He is affiliated with Stanford's Leinweber Institute for Theoretical Physics and is also a researcher on OpenAI's reasoning team. The paper proposes a background-independent, nonperturbative quantization of **vacuum general relativity in four-dimensional Lorentzian spacetime**.

**The core idea:** Instead of slicing spacetime into spatial snapshots, the author builds the theory from intersecting light cones that carve out finite causal diamonds. Gravitational constraints are solved on the null boundaries, the reduced phase space is promoted to an algebra of observables, and amplitudes are composed into a Lorentzian path integral in which each sum over intermediate states converges absolutely. A gravitational clock defined on the light cone then yields a discrete area spectrum and finite-dimensional Hilbert space for a bounded region.

**The checks reported:** The paper says it obtains a finite closed-form amplitude for graviton pair creation and annihilation — where expanding in Newton's constant first gives a logarithmic divergence — recovers the Bekenstein–Hawking entropy, reproduces Sen's 2013 coefficient 106/45 for the one-loop logarithmic correction of a large Schwarzschild black hole, and derives the semiclassical Einstein equations to one loop in the low-energy limit.

**The AI role:** The acknowledgments state that several calculations and proofs were developed through detailed, repeated collaboration with GPT-6 Astra over several months, consuming about 400 million OpenAI-supplied tokens. The paper does not specify which steps were done by the model, and it carries a single human author.

**Important limits:** Online claims of a solved theory of everything overstate the result. The paper treats vacuum gravity only, with no matter fields or the other three fundamental forces; it is a preprint that has not been peer-reviewed; and the author flags at least one heuristic step in a footnote. Physicists named as having discussed the draft — including Juan Maldacena and Andy Strominger — have not publicly endorsed it. Greg Brockman reposted the paper with the line, toward a deeper understanding of the universe.

**Sources:** arXiv original paper (abstract and full text), 机器之心 and 新智元 technical breakdowns, 腾讯新闻 and 新浪财经 coverage, and ExplainX claim-versus-verified analysis.

zh.title: 斯坦福物理学家联手 GPT-6 Astra 提出四维引力量子化框架
zh.excerpt: arXiv 一篇 83 页预印本宣称在四维时空实现真空广义相对论的背景无关、非微扰量子化，作者致谢披露与 GPT-6 Astra 协作数月、消耗约 4 亿 token。论文未经同行评审，也并非「大一统理论」。
zh.content:
**挂出了什么：** 11 月 25 日，Venkatesa Chandrasekaran 在 arXiv 提交论文《从光锥出发的引力代数量子化》（arXiv:2611.34924）。他隶属斯坦福大学 Leinweber 理论物理研究所，同时也是 OpenAI 推理团队研究员。论文提出一套对**四维洛伦兹时空中的真空广义相对论**做背景无关、非微扰量子化的方案。

**核心思路：** 作者不按传统的空间切片量子化，而是用相交的光锥围出有限的「因果菱形」，把引力约束解在光锥的零边界上，将约化相空间提升为可观测量代数，再把不同菱形的振幅拼接成洛伦兹路径积分，并证明有限牛顿常数下每一步对中间态求和都绝对收敛。定义在光锥上的「引力时钟」进一步给出离散面积谱和有界区域的有限维希尔伯特空间。

**论文自报的检验：** 论文称在光锥上非微扰算出引力子对产生与湮灭的有限闭式振幅，而先按牛顿常数展开则出现对数发散；复现贝肯斯坦-霍金熵，并把大史瓦西黑洞的单圈对数修正系数算回 Sen 在 2013 年用欧几里得路径积分得到的 106/45；最后在低能极限下导出一圈精度的半经典爱因斯坦方程。

**AI 的角色：** 致谢写明「若干计算和证明」是与 GPT-6 Astra 历时数月、来回协作完成的，共消耗约 4 亿 token。论文未披露哪些具体步骤由模型完成，作者仍为单人署名。

**必须说清的边界：** 网上「发现大一统理论」的说法超出证据。该文只处理真空纯引力，未纳入物质场与其余三种基本相互作用；它是未经同行评审的预印本；作者本人在脚注中承认至少一处用了启发式论证。致谢中提到的 Maldacena、Strominger 等学者只是讨论过或看过初稿，并未公开背书。OpenAI 总裁 Greg Brockman 转发时配文称「朝着更深地理解宇宙」。

**来源：** arXiv 原文（摘要与全文）、机器之心与新智元的技术解读、腾讯新闻与新浪财经报道，以及 ExplainX 的「声称 versus 已验证」对照分析。

en.title: China's Data Authority Drafts Rules to Let Lawful Data Feed AI Training
en.excerpt: The National Data Administration published a public consultation draft on November 26 covering twelve measures on data property rights, paid data use, and a risk-control duty for AI firms' outputs. Comments run through December 6.
en.content:
**The draft:** On November 26, China's National Data Administration (NDA) released the *Opinions on Improving Data Rules to Empower AI Innovation (Public Consultation Draft)*, seeking comments through December 6, 2026.

**Twelve measures in three areas:** The draft says data obtained through collection, generation, licensing or transfer can be used for AI training and inference, provided laws, contracts and others' rights are respected. It backs enterprises reusing data they lawfully gathered in normal operations, and supports paid data use. It also calls for clearer rules on derivative data, liability allocation in data circulation, and security governance.

**Output-side responsibility:** A closely watched clause requires AI firms, as technology providers, to take reasonable and necessary measures so outputs do not endanger national security or public interest, infringe privacy, trade secrets or copyright, or run against mainstream values. Firms must set up emergency response and complaint channels. Taking such measures can be a factual basis for reduced or exempted liability; failing to do so and causing harm brings legal responsibility.

**Why it matters:** The draft extends governance from the input side (where training data comes from) to the output side (what models generate), and signals that compliance spending becomes a variable in liability allocation rather than a pure cost.

**Sources:** Xinhua News Agency, Securities Times, Sina Finance (reprinting the NDA announcement), and Tencent News analysis.

zh.title: 国家数据局征求意见：合法数据可用于 AI 训练，AI 企业须建输出风险防控机制
zh.excerpt: 国家数据局 11 月 26 日发布《关于完善数据规则 赋能人工智能创新发展的若干意见》公开征求意见稿，三大方面十二项举措，把治理落点从数据来源端延伸到生成结果端，意见征集至 12 月 6 日。
zh.content:
**征求意见稿：** 11 月 26 日，国家数据局发布《关于完善数据规则 赋能人工智能创新发展的若干意见（公开征求意见稿）》，面向社会公开征求意见，时间为 2026 年 11 月 26 日至 12 月 6 日。

**三大方面十二项举措：** 稿件明确，各类主体通过采集生成、衍生创造或受让、授权许可等渠道取得数据持有权、使用权、经营权的，在不违反法律法规、合同约定且不侵犯他人合法权益的前提下，可用于人工智能训练和推理。支持企业对生产经营中合法采集的数据加以利用，鼓励为数据付费，并研究细化衍生数据认定规则、完善数据流通责任认定与安全治理机制。

**输出端责任：** 备受关注的条款要求 AI 企业作为技术提供方主动采取合理必要措施，不得生成危害国家安全、社会公共利益等法律法规禁止的内容，不得侵害隐私、商业秘密、著作权，并须建立应急处置机制与用户投诉反馈渠道。已采取合理必要措施的，可作为减轻或免除责任的事实依据；未采取措施并造成损害的，依法承担责任。

**意义：** 这份稿件把治理落点从「数据能不能用」延伸到「用了之后如何负责」，意味着合规投入不再只是成本项，而是责任分配中的变量。

**来源：** 新华社、证券时报、新浪财经（转载国家数据局公告）及腾讯新闻解读。

en.title: Tencent Lands Its First Nature Main-Paper as First Affiliation with AI-Designed Dual-Target Peptides
en.excerpt: Tencent Life Science Lab's ORIDTP platform designs high-potency dual-target therapeutic peptides from scratch. In mice, a GLP-1R/GCGR lead beat semaglutide at one-tenth the dose, while a PD-1/CTLA-4 lead shrank tumors by 94.2 percent.
en.content:
**The paper:** On November 26, Nature published *De novo design of high-potency dual-target therapeutic peptides with ORIDTP*, led by Tencent's AI for Life Sciences Lab with Shenzhen Institute of Advanced Technology and Chengdu University of TCM. It is Tencent's first paper in Nature as first-listed affiliation.

**The platform:** ORIDTP combines single-target knowledge transfer, dual-target reinforcement learning and experimental feedback to design dual-agonist peptides from scratch — moving validation beyond sequence generation and structure binding into cell function, animal efficacy and target dependence.

**Metabolic result:** For the GLP-1R/GCGR dual target, several peptides outperformed natural ligands in vitro. Lead peptide GA-Dual.R5.S3 achieved better weight loss and glucose control than semaglutide and mazdutide in obese or diabetic mice at one-tenth the semaglutide dose, without the nausea or taste aversion side effects.

**Immuno-oncology result:** For PD-1/CTLA-4, after a single design cycle, 8 of 15 candidates blocked both PD-1/PD-L1 and CTLA-4/CD80 — a 53 percent hit rate. Lead IC-Dual.P3 shrank tumors by 94.2 percent in a human PD-1/CTLA-4 knock-in colon cancer mouse model and increased intratumoral CD4 and CD8 T-cell infiltration, with activity dependent on both targets.

**The context:** Peptides sit between small molecules and antibody drugs in size and delivery. Dual-target designs are sought for complex diseases such as obesity, diabetes and cancer, but have been hard to engineer because improving one target often weakens the other. These are preclinical mouse results, not human trials.

**Sources:** Nature paper, 澎湃新闻, 新浪科技 and 网易 reporting.

zh.title: 腾讯以第一单位首登 Nature 主刊：AI 从头设计双靶点多肽，减重降糖与肿瘤免疫双线验证
zh.excerpt: 腾讯生命科学实验室 AI 平台 ORIDTP 实现高活性双靶点治疗性多肽从头设计。GLP-1R/GCGR 先导肽以十分之一剂量优于司美格鲁肽，PD-1/CTLA-4 先导肽使小鼠肿瘤体积缩小 94.2%。
zh.content:
**论文：** 11 月 26 日，《Nature》主刊刊发《De novo design of high-potency dual-target therapeutic peptides with ORIDTP》，由腾讯生命科学实验室主导，联合深圳理工大学、成都中医药大学团队完成。这是腾讯首次以第一署名单位登上 Nature 正刊。

**平台方法：** ORIDTP 整合单靶点知识迁移、双靶点强化学习与实验反馈优化，把验证深度从序列生成与结构结合推进到细胞功能、动物药效与靶点依赖性，形成完整证据闭环。

**代谢线：** 针对 GLP-1R/GCGR 双共激动剂，多条多肽体外活性优于天然配体。先导肽 GA-Dual.R5.S3 在肥胖或糖尿病小鼠模型中，仅用司美格鲁肽十分之一剂量即实现优于司美格鲁肽与玛仕度肽的减重降糖效果，且不引起恶心、味觉厌恶不良反应。

**肿瘤免疫线：** 针对 PD-1/CTLA-4，仅一个设计周期，15 条候选肽中 8 条可同时阻断两条通路，命中率 53%。先导肽 IC-Dual.P3 在双敲入结肠癌小鼠模型中使肿瘤体积缩小 94.2%，显著增加瘤内 CD4+、CD8+ T 细胞浸润，且抗肿瘤活性依赖这两个靶点。

**背景与边界：** 多肽药物介于小分子与抗体药之间，双靶点设计被视为攻克肥胖、糖尿病、肿瘤等复杂疾病的方向，但长期受制于「提此抑彼」的靶点平衡难题。以上均为小鼠临床前结果，尚未进入人体试验。

**来源：** Nature 论文原文，澎湃新闻、新浪科技、网易报道。

en.title: Anthropic Takes Claude Duet Preview Outside the US, Adding Japan and Three More Markets
en.excerpt: Claude Duet, an always-on agent that scans connected mail and calendars and works in the background, is now in research preview in Japan, India, Indonesia and Brazil — roughly a month after its US launch.
en.content:
**The expansion:** Anthropic product pages now list Japan, India, Indonesia and Brazil alongside the United States for Claude Duet's research preview. The company's Karan Ahuja announced the move on X on November 25 US time, and Japanese invitations began arriving on November 26.

**What Duet does:** Built on Claude Opus 5.5, Duet runs on a dedicated cloud computer and keeps working after the phone app is closed. It periodically checks connected Gmail, Slack and calendars, surfaces a morning brief of what needs attention, and can draft replies. Important actions such as sending messages, payments, signing documents and deleting data are held for user approval; credentials are isolated from the model.

**Access and limits:** Pro, Max and Ultra subscribers join a waitlist; Pro gets three full usage-limit resets during the preview, Max and Ultra one, with unused resets expiring December 15, 2026. Team plans are being enabled gradually by administrators, and Enterprise remains unsupported. Background work consumes the same plan allowance as normal chat.

**Why it matters:** Duet shifts the agent from waiting for a request to finding the work itself, and the overseas rollout lets Anthropic collect operational data on proactive agents outside the US. Permission management and audit of autonomous actions remain the key adoption questions.

**Sources:** AI News & Insight daily briefing, ITmedia AI+, PC Watch, BigGo Finance and Geekiki, cross-checked against Anthropic's product and help pages.

zh.title: Anthropic 将 Claude Duet 研究预览扩至日本等四国，首次走出美国
zh.excerpt: 可后台巡检邮件与日历、主动发现待办工作的智能体 Claude Duet，研究预览范围扩展至日本、印度、印度尼西亚和巴西，距美国上线约一个月。
zh.content:
**扩展范围：** Anthropic 产品页现已把日本、印度、印度尼西亚和巴西与美国并列，纳入 Claude Duet 的研究预览地区。公司成员 Karan Ahuja 于美国时间 11 月 25 日在 X 公布，日本用户 11 月 26 日起陆续收到邀请。

**Duet 能做什么：** 基于 Claude Opus 5.5，Duet 运行在云端专属计算机上，手机 App 关闭后仍继续工作。它定时巡检已连接的 Gmail、Slack 和日历，每天早上汇总需要注意的事项，并可起草回复。发送消息、付款、签署文件、删除数据等重要操作会等待用户批准，登录凭据与模型隔离。

**开放范围与限制：** Pro、Max、Ultra 订阅者加入等候名单，预览期内 Pro 获三次完整额度重置、Max 与 Ultra 各一次，未使用的重置于 2026 年 12 月 15 日失效。Team 计划由管理员逐步开放，Enterprise 暂不支持。后台工作与普通聊天共用同一额度。

**意义：** Duet 把智能体从「等指令」推进到「找活干」，海外扩展也让 Anthropic 得以收集美国之外的主动式智能体运行数据。权限管理与自主操作的审计，仍是企业采用的关键问题。

**来源：** AI News & Insight 每日简报、ITmedia AI+、PC Watch、BigGo Finance、Geekiki，并与 Anthropic 产品页及帮助页交叉核对。

en.title: SiYuan AI Chat Panel Flaw Lets Poisoned Model Replies Run Commands on Desktops
en.excerpt: CVE-2026-137469 is a DOM-based XSS in SiYuan 3.7.0 through 3.8.10. Because AI replies are rendered as HTML and desktop local-kernel mode enables Node.js integration, an injected reply can execute operating-system commands. Fixed in 3.8.11.
en.content:
**The vulnerability:** A National Vulnerability Database record published on November 26 describes CVE-2026-137469, a DOM-based cross-site scripting flaw in the AI agent chat panel of note-taking app SiYuan, affecting versions 3.7.0 up to but not including 3.8.11.

**The mechanism:** The panel renders final and saved assistant replies into innerHTML without sanitization. An attacker who can influence the model's reply — through indirect prompt injection in a page or document the agent reads, or via a configured model endpoint — can inject event-handler markup. In desktop local-kernel mode, Node.js integration lets that script call system-level functions, so the result is OS command execution rather than a browser pop-up.

**Why stored replies matter:** Both final and saved replies are affected. A single poisoned response can be re-triggered when the user reopens the conversation, not just at the moment it arrives.

**What is not known:** No source indicates the flaw has been exploited against real users, and no researcher or affected-installation count is named. NVD lists a GitHub advisory (GHSA-3rvg-qxwg-f3c6) and a VulnCheck advisory as references.

**What to do:** Upgrade to SiYuan 3.8.11 or later. The case is a recurring pattern in agent-enabled apps: model output is untrusted input, but the surrounding application treats it as developer code — and where it is rendered as HTML inside a privileged runtime, the gap to command execution is small.

**Sources:** NVD CVE-2026-137469 record, VulnCheck advisory, and The Agentic Times coverage.

zh.title: 思源笔记 AI 聊天面板漏洞：被投毒的模型回复可在桌面执行系统命令
zh.excerpt: CVE-2026-137469 是思源笔记 3.7.0 至 3.8.10 的 DOM 型 XSS。由于 AI 回复被当作 HTML 渲染，桌面本地内核模式下又启用 Node.js 集成，注入的回复可执行操作系统命令，3.8.11 已修复。
zh.content:
**漏洞：** 11 月 26 日发布的美国国家漏洞库（NVD）记录 CVE-2026-137469，是笔记应用思源笔记（SiYuan）AI 智能体聊天面板的 DOM 型跨站脚本漏洞，影响 3.7.0 至 3.8.10 版本。

**成因：** 该面板把最终回复和已保存回复直接渲染进 innerHTML，未做净化。攻击者若能影响模型回复——通过智能体读取的网页或文档做间接提示注入，或篡改配置的模型端点——即可注入事件处理器标记。在桌面本地内核模式下，Node.js 集成让这类脚本能调用系统级函数，结果不是浏览器弹窗，而是执行操作系统命令。

**已保存回复的风险：** 最终回复与已保存回复均受影响，一条被投毒的回复在用户重新打开会话时可被再次触发，而不只在到达那一刻生效。

**尚不清楚的部分：** 现有来源未显示该漏洞已在真实用户中被利用，也未点名研究者和受影响安装数量。NVD 列出 GitHub 安全公告 GHSA-3rvg-qxwg-f3c6 与 VulnCheck 公告作为参考。

**处置：** 升级至 3.8.11 及以上。这一案例反映了智能体应用的反复出现的模式：模型输出本是不可信输入，但外层应用把它当作开发者代码处理；当它在具特权的运行时中被当作 HTML 渲染，从 AI 功能到命令执行的距离非常短。

**来源：** NVD 的 CVE-2026-137469 记录、VulnCheck 公告及 The Agentic Times 报道。

en.title: Kioxia and Nvidia Test Using SSDs to Stretch GPU Memory to 1.1 Petabytes
en.excerpt: A proof of concept pairs an Nvidia GB200 NVL72 rack with 144 Kioxia 7.68 TB SSDs, using SCADA software to treat flash as extended GPU memory — about 60 TB per node and 1.1 PB in total.
en.content:
**The announcement:** Japanese flash-memory maker Kioxia said on November 26 it has begun a proof of concept with Nvidia to extend effective GPU memory to the petabyte scale using SSDs.

**The problem it targets:** As AI datasets grow, high-bandwidth memory capacity has become a constraint. Working within HBM alone can mean splitting workloads into small pieces and shuttling data between fast memory and slower storage.

**The setup:** The test system is an Nvidia GB200 NVL72 rack with 18 server nodes, fitted with 144 Kioxia XD8 Series 7.68 TB SSDs — eight per node. That yields about 60 TB of extended memory per node and roughly 1.1 PB in total. Nvidia's SCADA software turns the SSDs into extended GPU memory.

**The significance:** The approach attacks the GPU-memory shortage from the storage side rather than by adding more HBM. It is a proof of concept, so performance in production workloads and cost per usable terabyte have not been established.

**Sources:** AI News & Insight daily briefing summarizing Kioxia's November 26 statement.

zh.title: 铠侠与英伟达试点用 SSD 把 GPU 内存扩展到 1.1 PB
zh.excerpt: 测试系统以英伟达 GB200 NVL72 机架搭配 144 块铠侠 7.68 TB SSD，用 SCADA 软件把闪存当作扩展 GPU 内存——每节点约 60 TB、总计约 1.1 PB。
zh.content:
**消息：** 日本闪存厂商铠侠 11 月 26 日表示，已与英伟达启动概念验证，用 SSD 把 GPU 的有效内存扩展到 PB 级。

**针对的问题：** 随着 AI 数据集膨胀，高带宽内存（HBM）容量成为瓶颈。只依赖 HBM 意味着要把任务拆成小块，在快速内存与较慢存储之间反复搬运数据。

**测试配置：** 系统为一台英伟达 GB200 NVL72 机架，含 18 个服务器节点，装配 144 块铠侠 XD8 系列 7.68 TB SSD，每节点 8 块，因此每节点约 60 TB 扩展内存、总计约 1.1 PB。英伟达的 SCADA 软件把 SSD 转化为扩展 GPU 内存。

**意义与边界：** 这条路线从存储侧而非增加 HBM 来袭 GPU 内存短缺问题。目前仍是概念验证，生产负载下的实际性能与每可用 TB 成本尚未确定。

**来源：** AI News & Insight 每日简报，转述铠侠 11 月 26 日声明。

en.title: ElevenLabs Weighs New Round at a 33 Billion Dollar Valuation, Bloomberg Reports
en.excerpt: The UK voice-AI startup is in early talks for a round it aims to launch in the first quarter of 2027, targeting a 33 billion dollar valuation — 50 percent above its September mark — as annualized revenue rose to 700 million dollars.
en.content:
**The report:** Bloomberg reported on November 26, citing people familiar with the matter, that ElevenLabs is in early talks for a new funding round targeting a valuation of 33 billion dollars (about 219.9 billion yuan). The company plans to formally start the round in the first quarter of 2027.

**The numbers:** The proposed valuation is 50 percent above the 22 billion dollar mark set by an employee tender offer in September, continuing the company's habit of pricing rounds at multiples of eleven. Annualized recurring revenue has risen from 600 million dollars in September to 700 million dollars currently.

**Background:** Founded in London in 2022 by Polish entrepreneurs Mati Staniszewski and Piotr Dąbkowski, ElevenLabs builds generative audio tools — text-to-speech, speech-to-text, voice cloning and dubbing — sold through an API. It raised a 180 million dollar Series C in January 2025 and a 500 million dollar Series D in February 2026 led by Sequoia, with a16z, ICONIQ, Nvidia's NVentures and BlackRock participating. CEO Staniszewski has said the company aims to be IPO-ready by 2028.

**Caveat:** Discussions are preliminary and the valuation is a target, not a closed deal.

**Sources:** Bloomberg, via 智东西 and 网易 reporting.

zh.title: 彭博：英国语音 AI 公司 ElevenLabs 洽谈新融资，目标估值 330 亿美元
zh.excerpt: ElevenLabs 计划 2027 年一季度正式启动新一轮融资，目标估值 330 亿美元，较 9 月估值提升 50%；年化经常性收入已从 6 亿美元升至 7 亿美元。
zh.content:
**报道：** 彭博社 11 月 26 日援引知情人士消息称，英国 AI 语音初创公司 ElevenLabs 正就新一轮融资展开早期磋商，目标估值 330 亿美元（约合人民币 2199 亿元），计划在 2027 年前三个月正式启动。

**关键数字：** 拟议估值较今年 9 月员工要约收购时的 220 亿美元提升 50%，延续该公司以「11 的倍数」定价融资的惯例。年化经常性收入（ARR）已从 9 月的 6 亿美元增至目前的 7 亿美元。

**背景：** ElevenLabs 2022 年成立于伦敦，由波兰创业者 Mati Staniszewski 与 Piotr Dąbkowski 创办，研发生成式音频工具，提供文本转语音、语音转文本、声音克隆与 AI 配音，并通过 API 开放。2025 年 1 月完成 1.8 亿美元 C 轮，2026 年 2 月完成由红杉领投的 5 亿美元 D 轮，a16z、ICONIQ、英伟达 NVentures、BlackRock 等参投。CEO 表示目标在 2028 年前逐步完成上市准备。

**提示：** 相关讨论仍处初步阶段，330 亿美元是目标估值而非已完成的交易。

**来源：** 彭博社，经智东西、网易转述。

en.title: Chinese Humanoids Move onto Smartphone Production Lines as Lens Tech Deploys AgiBot G2
en.excerpt: Lens Technology and AgiBot will place dozens of G2 robots on a smartphone test line for loading, unloading and inspection. It follows a six-day live factory run at Longcheer in June, as Chinese firms push humanoids into real industrial work.
en.content:
**The deployment:** Chinese smartphone components maker Lens Technology has signed a strategic partnership with AgiBot (智元创新) to deploy dozens of AgiBot G2 robots on its smartphone test production line, according to reports on November 26 citing South Korea's Asia Daily.

**The task:** The G2 units will handle loading and unloading of parts and products at test stations and interact with test equipment to perform checks — a process chosen because it is repetitive and smartphone models change frequently.

**Why a humanoid:** The G2's stated advantage is generality. Conventional industrial automation is built for a specific line and often needs rebuilding when the line changes, whereas a general-purpose robot body can serve multiple lines, reducing equipment investment. It can also run continuously.

**Track record:** In June, AgiBot placed several G2 units on Longcheer Technology's mass-production factory in Nanchang, where during a six-day live broadcast they worked alongside line workers at real production speed in tablet quality inspection. AgiBot says it has completed the full path from process validation to line integration and on-site delivery.

**Context:** Research firm Omdia says Chinese vendors accounted for more than 97 percent of global humanoid shipments in the third quarter. AgiBot co-founder Peng Zhihui says the industry's core question has shifted from technical demos to whether robots can perform tasks at real sites every day.

**Sources:** 参考消息 citing Asia Daily, and 具身智能日报 industry roundup.

zh.title: 中国人形机器人走上智能手机产线：蓝思科技部署数十台智元精灵 G2
zh.excerpt: 蓝思科技与智元创新达成战略合作，将在手机测试产线部署数十台精灵 G2 机器人做上下料与检测。此前 6 月该机型已在龙旗科技南昌工厂完成 6 天产线直播验证。
zh.content:
**部署：** 据 11 月 26 日报道引述韩国《亚洲日报》，中国智能手机零部件企业蓝思科技与机器人企业智元创新达成战略合作，将在其运营的智能手机测试生产线上部署数十台智元精灵 G2 机器人。

**具体工序：** 精灵 G2 将在测试工位进行部件和产品的上下料，并与测试设备交互执行检查。该工序重复性强、手机型号更换频繁，因此被优先选中。

**为何用通用机器人：** 精灵 G2 主打通用性——传统工业自动化设备往往为特定工位定制，产线变更时需要改造重建，而通用本体可适应多条产线，减轻设备投资负担，并可全天候不间断作业。

**既往验证：** 6 月 23 日，智元已在龙旗科技江西南昌量产工厂投入多台精灵 G2，在为期 6 天的产线直播中承担平板量产质检工段，在实际生产速度下与工人连续协作。智元称已完成从工序适配验证到产线联动、现场交付的全过程。

**行业背景：** 研究机构 Omdia 数据显示，中国企业第三季度人形机器人出货量占全球总量 97% 以上。智元联合创始人彭志辉表示，产业核心问题已从技术演示转为能否在实际现场每天执行任务。

**来源：** 参考消息引述《亚洲日报》，及具身智能日报行业梳理。

en.title: Shanghai AI Lab Open-Sources Sage-Interaction for Interruptible Full-Duplex Multimodal Chat
en.excerpt: The model targets real-time interruptions and topic switches in voice dialogue and supports streaming video input. Reported figures — 1.29-second response latency and an 80.73 duplex quality score — come from the release and lack full evaluation detail.
en.content:
**The release:** Shanghai AI Laboratory has open-sourced Sage-Interaction, a multimodal interaction model designed to move dialogue from take-turns to continuous collaboration — handling interruptions and topic switches in speech and supporting streaming video input.

**Reported results:** According to AIbase coverage, the model has a response latency of 1.29 seconds and a full-duplex interaction quality score of 80.73, described as leading among open and closed duplex models. The report does not provide enough detail on model architecture, hardware conditions or evaluation protocol to generalize these numbers.

**Why it matters:** The work makes the ability to naturally break in — rather than waiting for a polite pause — an explicit evaluation target for interaction models. That is directly relevant to voice agents, real-time collaboration and multimodal assistants that must act while a user is still speaking.

**Caveat:** The figures are release-time vendor-reported results and should be treated as claims pending independent reproduction.

**Sources:** cnblogs AI technology daily for November 27, and the AI news roundup citing OpenMMLab's official announcement.

zh.title: 上海 AI Lab 开源 Sage-Interaction：面向可打断的全双工多模态交互模型
zh.excerpt: 该模型面向语音对话中的实时插话与话题切换，并支持流式视频输入。发布方给出的 1.29 秒响应延迟与 80.73 双工交互质量得分，缺少完整评测细节，应视为厂商自报结果。
zh.content:
**开源：** 上海人工智能实验室开源 Sage-Interaction，推动大模型从「一问一答」转向边交流、边协作、边办事，支持语音对话中随时打断与插话、话题切换，同时支持流式视频输入。

**自报数据：** 据 AIbase 报道，该模型响应延迟 1.29 秒，双工交互质量得分 80.73，被称为位居当前开闭源双工模型前列。报道未提供足够的模型结构、硬件条件与评测协议细节，因此这些数字不宜直接外推。

**意义：** 该工作把「能否自然接话」而非「等对方说完」作为交互模型的明确评测目标，对语音智能体、实时协作，以及需要在用户仍在说话时就动手的多模态助手具有直接参考价值。

**提示：** 上述数字为发布时的厂商自报结果，仍待独立复现。

**来源：** 博客园 2026 年 11 月 27 日 AI 技术日报，及引述 OpenMMLab 官方公告的 AI 新闻汇总。

en.title: SAP Weighs Cutting at Least 10,000 Jobs in AI Restructuring, Bloomberg Reports
en.excerpt: The German software maker is preparing a plan that would affect at least 9 percent of its global workforce, with product engineering and sales the main targets, as it redesigns how it builds and sells products.
en.content:
**The report:** Bloomberg, citing people familiar with the matter, reported that German software company SAP is preparing a plan to cut at least 10,000 jobs, affecting at least 9 percent of its global workforce. All departments have been asked to identify roles that could be eliminated, with product engineering and sales the main focuses.

**The restructuring:** As part of the change, SAP's leadership will continue redesigning its product development and sales model. The move is framed as an AI-era restructuring, though the report does not tie specific cuts to specific automation systems.

**Why it matters:** The plan is another signal that large software vendors are reshaping headcount around AI — a theme that has run through 2026 as companies move from piloting copilots to reorganizing entire product and go-to-market functions.

**Caveat:** The figures come from people familiar with the matter; no official SAP announcement with final numbers was cited in the report.

**Sources:** Bloomberg, via the 华尔街见闻 morning briefing for November 27.

zh.title: 彭博：SAP 拟在 AI 重组中裁减至少 1 万个岗位，涉及全球至少 9% 员工
zh.excerpt: 德国软件公司 SAP 正准备裁减至少 1 万个岗位，影响全球至少 9% 员工，产品工程与销售部门为重点，同时重新设计产品开发和销售模式。
zh.content:
**报道：** 彭博社援引知情人士报道，德国软件公司 SAP 正准备一项裁减至少 1 万个岗位的计划，将影响其全球至少 9% 的员工。所有部门均被要求梳理可能裁撤的空间，产品与工程部门以及销售部门是重点。

**重组内容：** 作为此次变革的一部分，SAP 领导层将继续重新设计其产品开发与销售模式。该计划被置于 AI 重组框架下，但报道未把具体岗位裁撤与特定自动化系统直接挂钩。

**意义：** 这是大型软件厂商围绕 AI 重塑人员结构的又一信号。2026 年以来，随着企业从试点副手工具走向重组整个产品与销售职能，这一主题反复出现。

**提示：** 数字来自知情人士，报道未援引 SAP 官方发布的最终人数公告。

**来源：** 彭博社，经 11 月 27 日华尔街见闻早餐转述。

en.title: Reuters: Compute Crunch Delays Chinese Flagship Models, GLM-5.5 May Slip to 2027
en.excerpt: New US export limits on remote access to restricted chips have slowed Z.ai's GLM-5.5 and could stretch Moonshot AI's release cycle from six months to a year or more, giving US rivals more time.
en.content:
**The report:** Reuters reported on November 26 that Chinese AI developers face a worsening compute squeeze. Z.ai (Zhipu AI), which had planned to release flagship GLM-5.5 in November, may now push it to 2027 due to R&D challenges and compute constraints. Moonshot AI could see the gap between major releases stretch from about six months to a year or longer if access to overseas compute infrastructure is limited.

**The policy backdrop:** A US Commerce Department rule introduced on November 19 expanded licensing requirements for advanced computing technology and targeted remote access to restricted processors. Reports say the measures have already paused AI server shipments for Nvidia's manufacturing partners in Southeast Asia.

**The competitive effect:** Restricted access to advanced compute undercuts one of Chinese developers' main advantages — producing competitive models at relatively low cost. Longer R&D cycles could give OpenAI, Google and Anthropic more time to expand enterprise businesses and improve models. The limits may also accelerate Chinese domestic semiconductor substitutes, a longer-term competitive risk for US chipmakers.

**Related front:** OpenAI and Anthropic have also stepped up defenses against unauthorized model distillation. An OpenAI document dated November 20 outlines efforts to prevent unauthorized extraction and coordinate safety measures with other AI developers.

**Caveat:** Timing details come from people familiar with the situations; release dates are not official.

**Sources:** Reuters exclusive, via 腾讯新闻 coverage.

zh.title: 路透：算力受限拖慢中国旗舰模型，智谱 GLM-5.5 或推迟至 2027 年
zh.excerpt: 美国对受限芯片远程访问的新规令中国 AI 开发商承压。原计划 11 月发布的 GLM-5.5 或推迟到 2027 年，月之暗面的发布周期可能从六个月拉长到一年以上。
zh.content:
**报道：** 路透社 11 月 26 日独家报道，中国 AI 开发商面临日益严重的算力瓶颈。智谱原计划 11 月发布旗舰机型 GLM-5.5，但因研发挑战与算力资源限制，发布时间可能推迟至 2027 年。知情人士称，若月之暗面的海外算力基础设施使用受限，其主要模型发布间隔可能从约六个月延长到一年甚至更久。

**政策背景：** 美国商务部 11 月 19 日出台新出口管制条例，扩大对先进计算技术的许可要求，并针对受限处理器的远程访问。据报道，这些措施已导致英伟达在东南亚制造合作伙伴的 AI 服务器出货暂停。

**竞争影响：** 先进算力受限削弱了中国开发商以较低成本产出有竞争力模型的主要优势之一，较长的研发周期可能给 OpenAI、谷歌和 Anthropic 更多时间拓展企业业务、改进现有模型。这些限制也可能加速中国自研半导体替代，构成对美国芯片厂商的长期竞争风险。

**相关动向：** OpenAI 与 Anthropic 同时加强了对未经授权模型蒸馏的防御。OpenAI 11 月 20 日的文件概述了防止未授权提取、并与其他 AI 开发者协调安全措施的努力。

**提示：** 时间表细节来自知情人士，并非官方发布日期。

**来源：** 路透社独家报道，经腾讯新闻转述。
